The plate is a white, triangular/wedge-shaped dish, likely about 20-24 cm along its long edge. It holds roughly 8 pieces of orange fruit that look like cantaloupe or melon chunks, each about 5-6 cm long, 2-3 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick. That is about 15-20 cm³ per piece, or about 15-18 g. Eight pieces come to about 130 g.
